root_idea.summary: A root orientation of contraction, drawing inward, and bodily thinness or hollowness.
root_idea.development: The semantic development centers on a shrunken or hollowed form: a lean belly, a slender waist, and the hollow of the foot; from the shrunken belly it extends to hunger and famine. The explanation connecting the garment term خميصة to the waist is presented as tentative.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun مَخْمَصَة is displayed under its normalized dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: Famine or hunger causing the belly to become shrunken or empty.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun denoting a state of hunger or famine; in the Quran it occurs in the construction فِي مَخْمَصَةٍ and in a context describing hunger as a hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foot rose from the ground, or had a hollow middle of the sole that did not touch the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal construction applied to the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shrink or draw away from something whose nearness is disliked; of night, to retreat or of its darkness to grow thinner before daybreak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary construction takes عَنْ; the nocturnal use describes the retreat or thinning of darkness before dawn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relinquish or yield a person's right or due to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form VI construction concerning a right or due owed to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bout or period of hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for an episode of hungering; one attested illustration describes hunger following repletion, without making that sequence a necessary restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hungry, with an empty or shrunken belly; also lank-bellied or slender in build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person or to the belly; it can also describe a time marked by hunger. Its plural forms describe people who are hungry or lank in the belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who abstains from devouring people's possessions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression, خَمِيصُ البَطْنِ مِنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ, describing abstention from consuming or appropriating others' property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soft, thin, small-bulk cloak or wrap, conventionally described as black, square, and bordered; also a bordered woollen or silk garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited descriptions emphasize ornamental borders, and one explicitly excludes an unbordered garment; details of material and color vary among the descriptions. The plural is خَمَائِص.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hollow or thin middle part of the human foot's sole that does not touch the ground when walking; also, a foot having such a hollow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun and related adjective applied to the human foot; the plural for the anatomical noun is أَخَامِص.
A distinct anatomical use of the same headword.
